title: Flat base change of bounded coherent complexes and their scalar-action morphisms
statement:
Let $R\to S$ be a flat homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], realized on the one-object ringed site. Write $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$ for objects whose cohomology is zero outside a finite interval and is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] in every degree. Use the internal Hom $R\operatorname{Hom}$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and derived extension of scalars [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and put $K_S=K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}S$. Every $K\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$ has $K_S\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(S)$. For $C,Z\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$ the canonical scalar-extension morphism
$$\beta_{C,Z}:R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,Z)\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}S\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_S(C_S,Z_S)$$
is an isomorphism in $D(S)$. For any object $L\in D(T)$, where $T$ is either ring, let $h_L:T\to R\operatorname{Hom}_T(L,L)$ be scalar action, namely the transpose of the unitor $T\otimes_T^{\mathbf L}L\to L$. Under the canonical identification $R\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}S\cong S$, one has
$$\beta_{C,C}\circ(h_C\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}S)=h_{C_S}.$$
In particular, if $h_C$ is an isomorphism then $h_{C_S}$ is an isomorphism, and if $R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,Z)=0$ then $R\operatorname{Hom}_S(C_S,Z_S)=0$. No finite projective or injective dimension is assumed.

proof.text: Write $F=-\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}S$. For a representative $A$ of $K$, [lem-trf-flat-projective-hom-models] gives $H^i(FK)\cong S\otimes_RH^i(K)$. The vanishing outside the given finite interval is therefore preserved. If $m_1,\ldots,m_r$ generate $H^i(K)$, then $1\otimes m_1,\ldots,1\otimes m_r$ generate its scalar extension: expand $m=\sum a_jm_j$ in each pure tensor $s\otimes m$ to obtain $\sum s f(a_j)(1\otimes m_j)$. Thus $K_S\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(S)$. No faithful-flatness or finite-dimensional resolution is used.

source.place: Flat-model computation of cohomology in Tag 0A6A(3); finite-generation conclusion is the displayed generator calculation

proof.text: The upper cohomology bound and finite cohomology of $C$ imply that $C$ is pseudo-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-pseudocoherent-cohomology-criterion]. The lower cohomology bound on $Z$ says exactly that $Z\in D^+(R)$. Apply [lem-trf-pseudocoherent-rhom-flat-base-change] with $E=C,L=Z$ and the given flat map. It gives precisely the canonical $\beta_{C,Z}$ as an isomorphism in $D(S)$, without any perfectness hypothesis.

Let $U$ be restriction, $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to UF$ the unit, and $\gamma:U R\operatorname{Hom}_S(FC,FC)\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,UFC)$ the evaluation-normalized isomorphism of [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction]. By the canonical-map description in [lem-trf-pseudocoherent-rhom-flat-base-change], the scalar-adjunction transpose of $\beta_{C,C}\circ F(h_C)$ is $\gamma^{-1}\circ R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,\eta_C)\circ h_C$. Apply $\gamma$ and then tensor-Hom transposition to both this map and the scalar-adjunction transpose of $h_{FC}$. The first becomes $\eta_C\circ\lambda_C:R\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}C\to UFC$, since $h_C$ transposes to $\lambda_C$. The second is the same map: evaluation normalization inserts $\eta_C$ and restricts the scalar action of $S$ along $R\to S$, giving $r\otimes x\mapsto f(r)\eta_C(x)=\eta_C(rx)$. The two adjunction bijections are injective, so the original arrows agree, under $F(R)\cong S$. This proves the required equality of canonical morphisms.

proof.text: If $h_C$ is invertible, then the functor $F$ carries its inverse to an inverse of $F(h_C)$, and Step 2 makes $\beta_{C,C}$ invertible; their composite is $h_{C_S}$ by Step 3. If $R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,Z)=0$, its scalar extension is zero (use the zero complex in the flat-model comparison of [lem-trf-flat-projective-hom-models]); the isomorphism of Step 2 then identifies $R\operatorname{Hom}_S(C_S,Z_S)$ with zero.

lean.statement: theorem flat_coherent_homothety_base_change {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : φ.Flat) : (∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj K)) → (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj K)) → (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} S) i).obj ((ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj K))) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite S ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} S) i).obj ((ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj K)))) ∧ (∀ C Z : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj C)) → (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj C)) → (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj Z)) → (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj Z)) → IsIso ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison (ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ) C).natTrans.app Z) ∧ (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ) ≫ (ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).map (MonoidalClosed.id C) ≫ (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison (ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ) C).natTrans.app C = MonoidalClosed.id ((ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj C)) ∧ (IsIso (MonoidalClosed.id C) → IsIso (MonoidalClosed.id ((ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj C))) ∧ (IsZero ((ordinaryModuleDerivedInternalHom R).obj (op C, Z)) → IsZero ((ordinaryModuleDerivedInternalHom S).obj (op ((ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj C), (ModuleCat.ordinaryDerivedExtendScalars φ).obj Z))))
